decisions.reason: Its visibility increased from a mere mention in 2023 to its own page in 2024, and as a close extension of the core modular sensing platform it likely meets aspirations well enough in a growing, resource-rich firm.

This module stayed on its own page across both years and was still explicitly promoted as new in 2024, suggesting satisfactory results relative to aspirations and little pressure to reallocate resources away from it.

Although it only remained mentioned rather than prominently featured, it is close to the established automation offer and the firm has enough organisational slack to continue carrying such a complementary module unless results clearly disappoint.

As a 2024 launch with limited website prominence it is still somewhat uncertain, but its fit with the existing control ecosystem and the firm’s expansionary posture make retention more likely than withdrawal.

Even as a new 2024 service, it supports the firm’s stated strategic move into networked charging and energy management, so management would likely tolerate early uncertainty and keep it unless performance falls well below aspiration.
